stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Kirsty Kochanski & Christopher Kochanski nose in front of Kylie Barac & Jesse Barac by 1, nerves well and truly in play.

stories.title: Family Affair
stories.detail: The Barac household pairing Kylie Barac & Jesse Barac card 70 gross, 59 net, and no family feud yet.

stories.title: Keeping it in the Family
stories.detail: Kirsty Kochanski & Christopher Kochanski keep the Kochanski name on the leaderboard and the ribbing in the car.

stories.title: Countback Territory
stories.detail: Deadlock on 60.75 net between Jodie Tancredi & Sharon McLoughlin and Narelle Jones & Kim Robinson, pencils at the ready.

stories.title: Too Close to Call
stories.detail: Can't split them, Narelle Jones & Kim Robinson and Jodie Tancredi & Sharon McLoughlin both sitting on +60.8.

stories.title: Pure Strikers
stories.detail: Olivia Skellern & Amy Green prove shots are optional, turning 0 into 0.

stories.title: Strokes to Spare
stories.detail: The generous end of the draw: Jodie Tancredi & Sharon McLoughlin with 17.25 and +60.8 to show for it.

stories.title: Strokes in the Bank
stories.detail: Narelle Jones & Kim Robinson lean on 9.25 and come up with 60.75 net after a 70 gross.

stories.title: In the Mix
stories.detail: Anna Allsopp & Dianne Pomeroy find the middle of the leaderboard with 82 gross for 65.75 net.

stories.title: In the Thick of It
stories.detail: Not the top, not the bottom - Anna Allsopp & Dianne Pomeroy on +65.8 and happy enough.

stories.title: Best-Ball Buddies
stories.detail: Nothing fancy from Lyn Stewart & Stephen Vane, just 71 gross, 63.5 net, and a good walk.

stories.title: Better Together
stories.detail: A bit of give and take and Kylie Barac & Jesse Barac end up with +59.

stories.title: Bringing Up the Rear
stories.detail: Susan Peters & Catherine Hogg wrap up on 77.5 net from 92 gross, having worn out two scorecards.

stories.detail: the race that stops a nation, the comp that stops the club - Cup Day golf
